description: Version range check: npm, PEP 440, Cargo, Maven — Parses a dependency version range in npm (node-semver), PEP 440 specifier, Cargo requirement or Maven range syntax and tests up to 100 candidate versions against it, for agents that write or review manifests. Returns per-version satisfies/violates with the failing comparator, the normalized range, the sorted versions and the highest match; pre-release, caret on 0.x, epoch and local-version rules f

ecosystem.description: Which range syntax and version ordering to apply.

prereleases.description: npm includePrerelease / PEP 440 prereleases=true. Default false (ecosystem default exclusion applies).

versions.description: Candidate versions to test; omit to only validate the range.

name: semver-check
